rate_limit_sufficiency: Live anonymous core limit was 60, with 56 remaining after repository checks; search limit was 10, with 9 remaining after query. Four per-repository core requests would require about 2400 for 600 repositories, excluding retries/supporting enrichment, so current anonymous allowance is not sufficient for one uninterrupted collection run. An authenticated quota check or explicitly scheduled collection is a bulk prerequisite.
recommendation: Use installed backend/.venv Python httpx with verified TLS for an approved bounded crawler. Check authenticated quota separately before bulk execution, preserve license ambiguity and evidence disagreements, and retain human approval as the ground-truth gate.
